title: Choose the visual world for Cash Flow Agent
question: The roll assigned Kinetic Sculpture. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Kinetic Sculpture
options.thesis: A structural network where every expense is a force that pulls on the budget tension.
options.viewport: Engineering monospaced labels tracing loads to counterforces on a concrete ground.
options.risk: Can feel too abstract and disconnected from familiar financial metaphors.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: Information density driven by pure typography and scale contrast.
options.viewport: Strict baseline grids where large type morphs to indicate available cash flow.
options.case: Extremely clean and focused, losing only slightly on immediate emotional impact.
options.risk: Lacks the warmth some users expect from personal finance tools.

options.label: Seven Segment Clock
options.thesis: Financial totals as unmissable, glowing scoreboard digits.
options.viewport: Rigid segment mask cells flipping instantly as expenses are categorized.
options.case: Highly visible and satisfying interactions; ties well into immediate feedback loops.
options.risk: Can feel abrasive or overly urgent for a household budgeting tool.

canonCard.label: The standard dashboard
canonCard.thesis: What every finance app ships, executed flawlessly.
canonCard.viewport: Standard top metrics row over a transaction list and pie chart.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
